labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks how to overwrite a line with \r; Rich strips carriage returns and the documented way is Live, so this is a usage question rather than a defect.

body:
Rich strips carriage returns from printed text, so `\r` can't move the cursor back to overwrite a line. For a line that updates in place, use the Live display: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst

If you have a question that isn't covered there, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the place to ask it.
